summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py, with thread-entry state initialised in the constructor and set/cleared in the run_app coroutine's try/finally. Added tests/test_call_from_thread.py with 9 tests covering not-running, same-thread, widget access, awaitable callables, timeout-exception propagation, variadic/keyword forwarding, and calls after stop. All 9 pass when run with PYTHONPATH pointing at the repo's src (the venv's .pth otherwise resolves to a separate base/src tree). Five existing async tests (test_call_later, test_unmount, test_screens) fail with "async def functions are not natively supported", which appears to be a missing async pytest plugin in the venv; not verified against the unmodified tree. Nothing committed.
